instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Independent film and TV production company developing scripted drama series and feature documentaries for streaming platforms and broadcasters. Slate of 6 projects in various stages of development and production. Evaluating AI-assisted script coverage and audience sentiment prediction tools for greenlight decisions. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management rather than speed.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets—potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion—provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently facing tight supply chains for specialized post-production hardware and high competition from major streamers who are rapidly increasing content volume. Maintaining creative quality while scaling production efficiency remains a constant challenge.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Script Coverage Pipeline (Conservative)
opportunities.rationale: Integrating AI to quickly assess script coverage against market trends allows for faster greenlight decisions without completely disrupting the established formal committee process. This addresses the 'time' barrier by accelerating the pre-production vetting phase.

first_actions: Pilot a third-party sentiment analysis tool on 5 new scripts.
Develop internal training modules for script coverage review teams.
resources_needed: 2 full-time project managers allocated to pilot
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of average greenlight lead time by 15%
milestones: Q3: Tool selection and vendor onboarding complete.
Q4: Pilot completion and internal feasibility report.

opportunities.title: Automated Talent Scouting & Pitch Tool (Conservative)
opportunities.rationale: Develop an internal CRM/scoring system focused on matching scripts to specific talent profiles and historical audience data. This leverages existing digital maturity by standardizing the 'informal conversations' feedback into quantifiable metrics for faster decision-making.

first_actions: Map current script metadata against existing production data points.
Integrate with existing CRM to automate lead scoring.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in successful project pitch conversion rate by 10%
milestones: Q3: MVP of the talent matching algorithm.
Q4: Integration into formal committee review workflow.

opportunities.title: Vertical IP Distribution Platform (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Transition from solely selling finished content to developing a proprietary 'Media-as-a-Service' platform that monetizes behind-the-scenes data and interactive fan experiences. This creates new, high-margin revenue streams independent of traditional broadcast licensing.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on building a dedicated VR/Interactive content hub.
Allocate €2M from the innovation fund for legal and tech architecture assessment.
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in IP monetization (€500,000)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 1% recurring revenue stream from platform features by Year 3
milestones: Q2: Detailed business case and architecture design.
Year 2: Launch of MVP interactive distribution module.

next_steps.action: Establish cross-functional task force to define requirements for the AI script coverage pilot.
Conduct a detailed ROI analysis for the 'Vertical IP Distribution Platform' radical opportunity using current market trends.

key_weaknesses: Slow internal innovation process (partial maturity limiting velocity)
High dependency on centralized formal committee approvals, causing bottlenecks in 'time' to market.
Limited operational capacity for radical shifts due to current budget allocation being heavily weighted towards maintaining existing production stability.
Risk of talent/IP leakage if decentralized innovation leads create unsecure external partnerships.
